entity.naturalist.alligator.description: A hostile mob found in Swamps, Mangrove Swamps, and Rivers that hunts Deer, Ducks, and other animals. Lays its Eggs on mud and sand.
entity.naturalist.anglerfish.description: An aquatic hostile mob found in Oceans that lures fish with the glowing lure on its head. Comes in red and glowing variants.
entity.naturalist.ant.description: A neutral mob found in Jungles and Savannas that can be tamed and carries food back to its Ant Hill. Healed with Sugar.
entity.naturalist.bass.description: An aquatic passive mob found in Swamps and Rivers. Comes in small, medium, and large sizes.
entity.naturalist.bear.description: A neutral mob found in Forests and Taigas that attacks players that come near its cubs. Can be tamed with Salmon, and its Fur can be sheared with Shears.
entity.naturalist.bird.description: A passive mob found in most Overworld biomes that can be tamed. Tamed Birds perch on your head and slow your fall.
entity.naturalist.black_bear.description: A neutral mob found in Forests, Taigas, and Groves that hunts fish and Deer and attacks players that come near its cubs. Can be tamed with Salmon and sheared for Fur.
entity.naturalist.blobfish.description: An aquatic passive mob found in Oceans that stays near the sea floor. Can be caught with a Bucket.
entity.naturalist.boar.description: A neutral mob found in Forests and Savannas that hunts Snakes and Snails. Can be tempted with Carrots, Potatoes, and Beetroot.
entity.naturalist.butterfly.description: A passive mob found in Forests, Plains, and Swamps that pollinates flowers and helps nearby crops grow. Comes in seven species.
entity.naturalist.capybara.description: A passive mob found in Jungles and Swamps that can be tamed with Melon Slices. Can be dyed and swims well.
entity.naturalist.caterpillar.descriptio: A passive mob that climbs walls and becomes a Chrysalis over time. Can be caught and released.
entity.naturalist.catfish.description: An aquatic mob found in Swamps that hunts Cod, Bass, and Tadpoles. Can be caught with a Bucket.
entity.naturalist.clam.description: An aquatic passive mob found on the ocean floor that can hold an item inside its shell. Sneak up to it to take the item, or store one of your own.
entity.naturalist.crab.description: A passive mob found on Beaches and Stony Shores that can be tamed and picks up dropped items with its claws. Occasionally drops a Nautilus Shell.
entity.naturalist.deer.description: A passive mob found in Forests and Cherry Groves that flees from players and predators. Drops Venison and Antlers.
entity.naturalist.desert_scorpion.descri: A hostile mob found in Deserts and Badlands that stings with poison. Occasionally drops a Scorpion Poison Gland.
entity.naturalist.dragonfly.description: A passive flying mob found in Swamps that hovers in place. Frogs eat them and cough up Froglass.
entity.naturalist.duck.description: A passive mob found in Swamps and Rivers that can be tamed with raw fish. Babies can be caught in a Bucket.
entity.naturalist.elephant.description: A neutral mob found in Savannas that can be tamed with Cake. Can be saddled, given a Chest, and decorated with a Banner.
entity.naturalist.firefly.description: A passive flying mob found in Forests, Plains, Swamps, and Mushroom Fields that hides in grass when startled. Drops Glow Goop.
entity.naturalist.giant_isopod.descripti: An aquatic passive mob found in Oceans that curls into a ball when threatened. Can be caught with a Bucket.
entity.naturalist.giraffe.description: A tall passive mob found in Savannas that can be tamed and ridden. Maps can be used while riding one.
entity.naturalist.great_white_shark.desc: A hostile aquatic mob found in warm Oceans that hunts fish and drags players underwater. Drops Teeth.
entity.naturalist.hedgehog.description: A passive mob found in Forests, Plains, Meadows, and Taigas that can be tamed and curls into a ball when panicked. Can be picked up and thrown.
entity.naturalist.hippo.description: A neutral mob found in Savannas and Jungles that can be tamed with Melon Slices. Attacks players that enter the water.
entity.naturalist.jellyfish.description: An aquatic passive mob found in Oceans that stings anything that touches it. Comes in five colors.
entity.naturalist.jungle_scorpion.descri: A hostile mob found in Jungles that stings with poison. Occasionally drops a Scorpion Poison Gland.
entity.naturalist.komodo_dragon.descript: A hostile mob found in Badlands, Savannas, Deserts, and Jungles that basks in the sun and poisons whatever it bites. Hunts Lizards, Snakes, and Boars.
entity.naturalist.lion.description: A neutral mob found in Savannas that hunts Rhinos, Zebras, and Boars in a pride. Can be tamed with raw meat.
entity.naturalist.lizard.description: A passive mob found in Swamps, Deserts, Jungles, Forests, and Savannas that can be tamed and dyed. Drops its tail when hurt.
entity.naturalist.mammoth.description: A neutral mob found in Snowy Plains, Ice Spikes, Snowy Slopes, and Frozen Peaks that can be tamed with Cake. Can be saddled and given a Chest.
entity.naturalist.mole.description: A passive mob found underground in Forests and Plains that digs through the ground and leaves Dirt Trails. Wolves will dig it out.
entity.naturalist.ostrich.description: A neutral mob found in Savannas that can be tamed with seeds and saddled. Defends its Eggs from attackers.
entity.naturalist.piranha.description: An aquatic hostile mob found in Jungles that hunts Cod and Salmon in shoals. Can be caught with a Bucket.
entity.naturalist.rat.description: A passive mob found in Forests and Plains that can be tamed and climbs walls. Steals crops from Farmland.
entity.naturalist.ray.description: An aquatic passive mob found in Oceans that stings with a venomous barb. Comes in Stingray, Eagle Ray, and Mobula Ray variants.
entity.naturalist.rhino.description: A hostile mob found in Savannas that charges at players. Its charge destroys Crops and Flowers.
entity.naturalist.snail.description: A passive mob found in most Overworld biomes that climbs walls and lays Snail Eggs. Can be crushed by walking on it.
entity.naturalist.snake.description: A neutral mob found in Forests, Plains, and Swamps that can be tamed and poisons whatever it bites. Comes in Snake, Rattlesnake, and Coral Snake variants.
entity.naturalist.starfish.description: An aquatic passive mob found on the ocean floor that can be caught with a Bucket. Placed Starfish spread across nearby blocks.
entity.naturalist.tiger.description: A neutral mob found in Jungles, Swamps, and Mountains that stalks its prey and can be tamed with raw meat. White Tigers, Leopards, and Black Panthers are variants.
entity.naturalist.tortoise.description: A passive mob found in Swamps, Deserts, and Jungles that can be tamed with Bamboo and hides in its shell when hurt. Lays its Eggs on sand and mud.
entity.naturalist.turkey.description: A passive mob found in Forests and Taigas that hunts Ants and takes no fall damage.
entity.naturalist.vulture.description: A hostile flying mob found in Savannas, Badlands, and Deserts that attacks undead mobs and perches on Cacti. Its pecks cause Hunger.
entity.naturalist.whale.description: An aquatic passive mob found in Oceans that dives deep and spouts at the surface. Drops Fish and Fat.
entity.naturalist.zebra.description: A passive mob found in Savannas that can be tamed through riding and given a Chest.
effect.naturalist.antivenom.description: An effect that instantly cures Poison.
lore.naturalist.alligator_egg: An Egg laid by an Alligator on mud, sand, or dirt. Hatches into a baby Alligator, but breaks if stepped on.
lore.naturalist.anglerfish: A raw fish that can be eaten or cooked. Dropped by Anglerfish, which may also drop Glowstone Dust.
lore.naturalist.ant: An item carrying a live Ant. Can be placed to release it.
lore.naturalist.ant_hill: A block that Ants store food inside. A hill holding a Queen Ant drops her when broken, and she can be placed to start a new hill.
lore.naturalist.antler: An item dropped by Deer. Can be brewed into a Potion of the Forest Dasher.
lore.naturalist.azure_froglass: A translucent block that a Frog coughs up after eating a Blue Dragonfly. Can be crafted into panes.
lore.naturalist.azure_froglass_pane: A thin pane of Azure Froglass. Can be used as a window.
lore.naturalist.bass: A raw fish that can be eaten or cooked. Dropped by Bass.
lore.naturalist.blobfish: A raw fish that can be eaten or cooked. Dropped by Blobfish.
lore.naturalist.blue_starfish: A Starfish that can be placed on the sea floor. Spreads across nearby blocks over time.
lore.naturalist.bushmeat: A meat that can be eaten raw or cooked. Dropped by Boars, Capybaras, Elephants, and other large animals.
lore.naturalist.butterfly: An item carrying a live Butterfly. Can be placed to release it.
lore.naturalist.capture_net: A tool that can catch Ants, Crabs, Snails, and other small creatures alive.
lore.naturalist.catfish: A raw fish that can be eaten or cooked. Dropped by Catfish.
lore.naturalist.caterpillar: An item carrying a live Caterpillar. Can be placed to release it.
lore.naturalist.chrysalis: A block spun by a Caterpillar. Hatching turns it into a Butterfly, unless collected with Shears or Silk Touch.
lore.naturalist.clam_meat: A meat that can be eaten raw or cooked. Dropped by Clams.
lore.naturalist.cooked_anglerfish: A fish that restores more saturation than Anglerfish.
lore.naturalist.cooked_bass: A fish that restores more saturation than Raw Bass.
lore.naturalist.cooked_blobfish: A fish that restores more saturation than Blobfish.
lore.naturalist.cooked_bushmeat: A meat that restores more saturation than Bushmeat.
lore.naturalist.cooked_catfish: A fish that restores more saturation than Raw Catfish, more than any other fish.
lore.naturalist.cooked_clam_meat: A meat that restores more saturation than Clam Meat.
lore.naturalist.cooked_crab_meat: A meat that restores more saturation than Crab Meat.
lore.naturalist.cooked_drumstick: A meat that restores more saturation than a Drumstick.
lore.naturalist.cooked_duck: A meat that restores more saturation than Raw Duck.
lore.naturalist.cooked_egg: An Egg cooked in a Furnace, Smoker, or Campfire.
lore.naturalist.cooked_lizard_tail: A meat that restores more saturation than Lizard Tail. Cooking removes the poison.
lore.naturalist.cooked_mammoth_meat: A meat that restores more saturation than Raw Mammoth Meat.
lore.naturalist.cooked_piranha: A fish that restores more saturation than Piranha.
lore.naturalist.cooked_venison: A meat that restores more saturation than Venison.
lore.naturalist.crab: An item carrying a live Crab. Can be placed to release it.
lore.naturalist.crab_meat: A meat that can be eaten raw or cooked. Dropped by Crabs.
lore.naturalist.crimson_froglass: A translucent block that a Frog coughs up after eating a Red Dragonfly. Can be crafted into panes.
lore.naturalist.crimson_froglass_pane: A thin pane of Crimson Froglass. Can be used as a window.
lore.naturalist.cut_shellstone: A clean-edged block cut from two Shellstone Slabs. Can be cut into slabs, stairs, and walls.
lore.naturalist.drumstick: A meat that can be eaten raw or cooked. Dropped by Turkeys and Ostriches.
lore.naturalist.duck: A meat that can be eaten raw or cooked. Dropped by Ducks.
lore.naturalist.duck_egg: An Egg laid by a Duck. Can be thrown, cooked, or used in place of a Chicken Egg in Cake and Pumpkin Pie.
lore.naturalist.fat: An item dropped by Boars, Mammoths, and Whales.
lore.naturalist.fur: An item dropped by Bears and other furry animals. Can be sheared from a Bear with Shears.
lore.naturalist.giant_isopod_bucket: A bucket carrying a Giant Isopod.
lore.naturalist.glow_goop: An item obtained by smelting Glow Berries or dropped by Fireflies. Up to three can be placed in one block, and it can be crafted into Spectral Arrows.
lore.naturalist.hedgehog: An item carrying a live Hedgehog, curled into a ball. Can be thrown at mobs to damage them.
lore.naturalist.hide: An item dropped by large animals. Can be crafted into a Knapsack or smelted into Leather.
lore.naturalist.knapsack: An item that can carry a single baby animal inside. Crafted from Hide.
lore.naturalist.lizard_tail: A meat that isn't safe to eat raw, as it causes food poisoning. Dropped by Lizards when hurt.
lore.naturalist.mammoth_meat: A meat that can be eaten raw or cooked. Dropped by Mammoths.
lore.naturalist.morsel: A small meat that can be eaten raw. Dropped by Rats, Lizards, Snakes, and other small animals.
lore.naturalist.music_disc_death_by_hogs: A music disc that plays Death by Hogs by Ninni when used in a Jukebox.
lore.naturalist.music_disc_wild_ones: A music disc that plays Wild Ones by Chips the Cat when used in a Jukebox.
lore.naturalist.orange_starfish: A Starfish that can be placed on the sea floor. Spreads across nearby blocks over time.
lore.naturalist.ostrich_egg: A huge Egg laid by an Ostrich on sand or dirt. Breaking it angers nearby Ostriches.
lore.naturalist.piranha: A raw fish that can be eaten or cooked. Dropped by Piranha.
lore.naturalist.plush_bear: A soft Bear plush that can be placed. Crafted from Wool and String.
lore.naturalist.purple_starfish: A Starfish that can be placed on the sea floor. Spreads across nearby blocks over time.
lore.naturalist.queen_ant: An item that can be used on the ground to place a new Ant Hill.
lore.naturalist.rat: An item carrying a live Rat. Can be placed to release it.
lore.naturalist.red_starfish: A Starfish that can be placed on the sea floor. Spreads across nearby blocks over time.
lore.naturalist.scorpion: An item carrying a live Scorpion. Can be placed to release it.
lore.naturalist.scorpion_poison_gland: An item dropped by Scorpions. Can be brewed into a Potion of Antivenom.
lore.naturalist.shellstone: A building block made from Snail Shells and Calcite. Can be smelted smooth or crafted into bricks.
lore.naturalist.shellstone_bricks: Shellstone that has been crafted into bricks.
lore.naturalist.smooth_shellstone: Shellstone that has been smelted until smooth.
lore.naturalist.snail: An item carrying a live Snail. Can be placed to release it.
lore.naturalist.snail_eggs: A block of Snail Eggs that hatches into baby Snails when stepped on.
lore.naturalist.snail_shell: An empty Snail Shell that can be placed as a decoration. Can be dyed, potted, or crafted into Shellstone.
lore.naturalist.tooth: An item dropped by Alligators, Lions, Snakes, and Sharks.
lore.naturalist.tortoise_egg: An Egg laid by a Tortoise on dirt, sand, or mud. Hatches into a baby Tortoise.
lore.naturalist.venison: A meat that can be eaten raw or cooked. Dropped by Deer.
lore.naturalist.verdant_froglass: A translucent block that a Frog coughs up after eating a Green Dragonfly. Can be crafted into panes.
lore.naturalist.verdant_froglass_pane: A thin pane of Verdant Froglass. Can be used as a window.
lore.naturalist.whistle: A tool that can be used on a tamed pet to switch it between following and wandering.
